articles.title: Teen Invents Plant-Based Plastic That Eats Microplastics
articles.summary: Arya Satheesh, 18, created Eco Purge — a plant-based plastic that breaks down microplastics in soil and water. Her invention won a European science prize and $12,500.

articles.title: Naruto Fans, Get Ready: New Anime News Is Coming!
articles.summary: After years of waiting, Naruto fans will finally learn about the new anime project at New York Comic Con on Oct. 10. The panel is called 'Naruto: What's Next.'

articles.title: Space Robots Need a Tune-Up: Why AI Isn't Ready to Fly a Spaceship
articles.summary: In movies, AI runs whole spaceships. In real life, today's AI still makes stuff up and needs humans watching. NASA uses it for Mars rovers and satellites, but a robot that can handle space all by itself? Not yet.
